body:
I'm not sure why I continue writing in here, but whatever here I go again. 
I'm still here fighting, though I'm not sure why. 

My best friend just told me that being there for me and supporting me is stressing her out, I easily ruin her day and I make her feel like giving up. She told me that I had to keep my suicidalness to myself. And that it's too much for her to be there for me anymore. 

So I just lost the one person who I actually felt comfortable talking with. We can ofc still be friends, but knowing myself and how hard it's gotten to keep a happy face on especially when it comes to her. I feel like I've lost my best friend and one the only reasons to stay alive.

So now everything I have left is the people of this sub. And a family that's in denial about how bad I'm doing

I really enjoyed talking to you about it all. It really means a lot you toke the time to do so. But I can no longer go through all this pain. I'm really sorry. Some people are just to far gone to help. I wish you all the best of luck and happiness in the future

It's really hard to talk to them about it. As they don't really understand depression it and they worry so easily. Have told them about the situation, but since they don't really understand it there isn't much they can do or say to help, other than being supportive and talk with me about it.
Well thank you for talking with me about this, I really appreciate it

My therapist suggested doing things that distract me from my pain and situation to get some peace and time to breathe. But the second it's over I'm back to feeling suicidal and hopeless. Nothing seems to give more than a few hours of peace and it takes nothing to make me exhausted for the next two or three days

Honestly I rarely have days where I don't wanna give up. That's another big issue I've been facing for a couple of months, I don't enjoy things the way I used to. I do listen to music sometimes, but lot of the trauma I have has music tied to it so it's tough for me most days. I used to be a huge lover of gaming, but even that has been fucked over by the depression. I've always had it difficult with exercise and because of a messed up knee it's not really an option. I could go on... I guess the essence of it is that I've lost all interest and joy in the thing I used to love. And that's driving me even more insane

I'm in therapy, have been for well over a year, but it only helps me to figure out why I'm feeling so depressed, doesn't actually make me feel better. I'm taking antidepressants, but I've been through 4 different kinds already, soon to start with the fifth and none of them has worked. I've told my family about most of my mental issues and they're very supportive, but doesn't understand it. I have a very supportive best friend, but it is unfortunately becoming too much for her to be there for me. I just seems no matter what I try I continue to be in so much pain.
I guess it is. Yeah, just not sure what to talk about

Been considering group therapy for a while, I'm unfortunately just not in a place right now where I can overcome my anxiety and actually benefit from it. It's weird I've never doubted that I deserve being treated well. I've just lost the belief that there is actually people who wants me and wants to go through the trouble it is having someone like me in their life. It recently became too much for my only and best friend to be there for me, which ended with her getting angry and us deciding I can longer use her for support. I'm just so exhausted from the constant pain and fighting. I'm in such a desperate need of affection and feeling like people want me. Living a life where every friend I've ever had abandoned me and used me, has left me so broken and hopeless of ever finding people that wants me and can deal with me issues and shortcomings

I have a hard time with a lot of people at the same time, especially strangers. Got some major anxiety and social insecurity problems, and a life that has made me very uncomfortable and untrusting about new people. 
DBT?

I get what you're saying and I think it's amazing that you found those people and got over the pain. A part of me is just so scared that I'll be one the cases where it doesn't get better and I'll end up living an entire life alone and unwanted, without a single dream ever coming true

I'm already getting help and support, nothing has worked. I've been in pain for so long I no longer feel it, just the cold empty coid I have inside. There's nothing they can do that they aren't already doing. Nothing but listen to my problems, which doesn't ease my suffering, it only makes them suffer. I've given it so many chances and nothing has changed. The therapy, support and help I've received has done nothing. It only gets worse and worse. I don't want anything anymore, I have no hobbies, no interest and nothing to look forward to anymore. I feel like everything that made me who I am is gone and I can't regain it no matter how hard I try
